transcript.text: Good to have everyone here. We need to finalize the voting package for Saturday's live finale, and I want to make sure we get all the right people in the room for the pre-air lock meeting before we document and sign off. Let's start by hearing from each of you on what you're seeing from your side.

transcript.text: Thanks, Mara. From Standards and Practices, I need to flag that we have an updated standards memo that was issued after the current draft voting rules were circulated. The memo sets some specific requirements for the voting package that may not be reflected in the draft yet. I'd like to get those on the table before we finalize anything.

transcript.text: I need to flag something critical from my side. I completed the platform certification test this morning, and the SMS integration failed certification — only the web portal passed. The approved portal requires account verification before a vote is accepted. This directly affects the current draft, which allows voting by both SMS and online portal. We can't proceed with SMS voting on Saturday unless that integration is retested and passes.

transcript.text: I need to flag a rights issue from my side. I obtained the finalist label's written approval today, and it confirms that the voting interface may display finalist names and approved headshots, but it may NOT use any finalist performance audio or video.
